summary: Steep, narrow kerb with houses 1-6 m from it along its length.
reasons: Narrow lane with no clear room to stop

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings at 6 m near 16 m and 38 m along, and 1 m at the top end; the gaps between are under a van length of clear frontage.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed lane; cars park on the opposite kerb, leaving little width beside the lane.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side street off a busier road at the start.
drivers.convention: A few cars parked on the opposite side, none clearly on this kerb.

flags: Narrow lane with trees and a pole at the kerb
sun_shade: Heavy tree and house shade from the east and south.
